==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am gifted a banquet of food to try. Each dish at the table was crafted from the same ingredients but looks and tastes different. I am encouraged to try a little from each plate.

I find myself especially liking one of the dishes and focusing on that one. A ninja with ice powers steals the dish from me and threatens to eat all the dishes. I fight him off only to turn around and see that all the dishes had been consumed by a swarm of other warriors.

One of the warriors brings up a food subscription service called Food Hero and I am immediately ticked off. I accuse the warriors of being paid off by Food Hero to eat all my food. The warriors pretend as if they have no idea what I am talking about.
